description: This source file defines an enum OutputFormat with associated methods to generate text in different formats (txt and srt) from attributed transcript data, including time formatting for subtitles.

methods.name: needsAudioTimeRange
methods.description: Determines if the output format requires audio time range information.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Generates formatted text from a transcript depending on the output format, either plain text or subtitle format including timestamps.
